author: CNN
description: President Trump kicked off his second term promising to be a "peacemaker." But now he's struggling to end two widening wars: the one he started with Iran, and the one he inherited between Russia and Ukraine. CNN's Kevin Liptak explains.
title: Trump's 'peacemaker' promise collides with reality

author: CNN
description: President Donald Trump is a former real estate developer, and it's clear that he believes the changes he has made (and hopes to make) to Washington, DC, landmarks will be a key part of his legacy. CNN's Betsy Klein takes a tour of the different spots where Trump has left his mark, and where he aspires to.
title: Touring Donald Trump's Washington, DC

author: CNN
description:
Everyone has an opinion about the best fabric for hot weather—but do different materials actually keep you cooler?

In this episode of Field Proof, our outdoors editor, Kai, tests six sun hoodies made from six different materials to find out whether one fabric really performs better than the rest. From natural fibers to high-performance synthetics, each hoodie is put through the same series of tests to discover what actually makes a material feel cooler.

We test each hoodie for:

Moisture wicking
Drying speed
Airflow
Heat retention
Real-world cooling feel after a one-mile run

By the end, we'll answer whether some materials genuinely keep you cooler, why certain fabrics perform better than others, and which one we'd actually recommend for hiking, running, and hot summer days.

-----------------------
0:00 - Intro
0:52 - What makes clothing cooling? Outdoor Research interview
1:44 - Moisture wicking test
2:12 - Drying speed test
2:26 - Breathability / airflow test
2:49 - Heat retentio
title: We ran the same hill 5 times to find the coolest fabric | Field Proof

author: CNN
description: CNN is on the ground in Le Porge, southwest France, and ground zero of what has become France's largest wildfires on record. CNN's Melissa Bell meets a local that has lost everything to the fires.
title: Ground zero of France's devastating wildfire

author: CNN
description: Colin Gray, the Georgia father whose teenage son Colt killed four people in a 2024 school shooting, was sentenced to 15 years in prison in a landmark case testing the limits of who can be held responsible for a mass shooting. title: Colin Gray sentence leaves families and survivors disappointed

author: CNN
description:
A record-high 73% of US adults say that President Donald Trump hasn’t paid enough attention to the country’s most important problems, a new CNN poll conducted by SSRS finds, with just 27% saying he’s had the right priorities. 

That comes amid increasingly bleak views of the Iran war, stagnating economic unhappiness, and broad discontent about Trump’s approach to these challenges.

The CNN NewsNight panel reacts to these results as midterm elections are fast approaching and to Trump’s focus on mail-in ballots.

title: Record Heat Expands Across the Western US

author: CNN
description:
President Donald Trump said Thursday that he wouldn’t object to temporarily withdrawing Todd Blanche as his nominee for attorney general amid resistance from GOP senators John Cornyn and Thom Tillis, another major blow to Blanche’s confirmation battle.

The president’s announcement puts Blanche’s nomination in even further peril, escalating a battle between the administration and GOP lawmakers over a controversial $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund and an agreement that shields Trump and his family from government action over tax issues.

Cornyn and Tillis have signaled they are unwilling to support Blanche’s nomination if the administration does not take action to unwind the fund and modify the settlement agreement, and the nomination cannot move forward without their support.

title: Trump attacks GOP senators rejecting Blanche

author: CNN
description: Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment more than 100 times during questioning that included repeated attacks from Republican Sen. Rand Paul at a Senate Homeland Security Committee hearing. CNN’s Jake Tapper breaks down their years-long clash over pandemic restrictions, Covid-19’s origins and US-funded virus research in Wuhan, China.
title: The long-running feud between Rand Paul and Dr. Fauci

author: CNN
description: If you live in the US, you have likely passed a Flock Safety camera. They log cars' details, capture images of people and feed data into one searchable system across 49 states. Some police officers have reportedly been caught misusing the technology. A number of residents are pushing back, worried about the technology and wanting their cities to reconsider. Flock told CNN it has worked to fix problems with its technology, and says its cameras have helped solve around 700,000 crimes a year.
title: Why are people destroying these cameras across the US?

author: CNN
description: The Michigan primary to select the Democratic Party’s nominee for US Senate is pitting progressives against centrists. Donie O'Sullivan talks to activist and streamer Hasan Piker and Democratic Party veteran James Carville, both of whom have very different visions for what kind of candidates will bring Democrats success in the November’s midterms. Watch more on CNN’s The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper: The Left Insurgency, Sunday, August 2, at 8pm ET.
title: Piker v Carville: How Far Left Should the Democrats Go

title: Father of Georgia school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison

description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, the mother who pleaded not guilty to the 2023 strangling of her three children, has raised questions about postpartum psychosis. CNN's Jacqueline Howard spoke with Dr. Veerle Bergink, one of the leading experts, about the lack of research and understanding about the disorder.
title: Postpartum expert: US is in ‘the Middle Ages’

title: This drone found an ‘invisible’ Chinese warship

author: CNN
description:
Less than 100 days before the midterms, voters are agitating for wholesale change in Congress and looking to the Democratic Party in hopes of making that happen. 

Democrats lead Republicans on the generic ballot by 8 points among registered voters, according to a new CNN poll conducted by SSRS. Democrats also continue to hold a significant advantage in voter enthusiasm and have a 20-point advantage in preferences among those who say they are extremely motivated to vote. 

CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten and CNN political director David Chalian break down the new numbers. Also, CNN This Morning's "group chat" weighs in on the issues facing both parties ahead of fall elections.

11:23 What will Republicans' message to voters be this fall?

title: 'Absolutely huge shift': Poll reveals Trump, GOP red flags

description: A French student will have to pay a fine of $465 after he posted a video of himself licking a straw from a vending machine in Singapore and putting it back. The student pleaded guilty to a public nuisance charge. CNN's Saskya Vandoorne reports.
title: Student fined for licking a straw

author: CNN
description: New research suggests data centers have an alarming and overlooked environmental impact: heat pollution. CNN's Laura Paddison reports.
title: Could data centers be heating up towns like this?

description: Jared Leto has denied sexual assault allegations revealed in a new BBC documentary. Four women accused the musician and Oscar-winning actor of sexual misconduct when they were teenagers. Leto denied the allegations in a statement to The Associated Press, saying, "These claims are absolutely and categorically false."
title: Jared Leto denies sexual assault allegations

author: CNN
description: Three people were taken to a hospital after two trucks collided Monday on a highway in Fayette County, in northeastern Iowa. According to the Fayette County Sheriff's Office, one driver failed to obey a stop sign, causing the trucks to crash into each other before hitting a Chevy Impala waiting at the intersection. All three vehicles were totaled, and the crash remains under investigation. The video was captured by the dashcam of a truck that was stopped at the intersection.
title: Severe truck collision caught on dashcam

author: CNN
description:
A fire that broke out on two vessels, included one US-owned, at an Egyptian port on Wednesday was caused by a drone, Cairo confirmed, marking first time Egyptian infrastructure has been struck. It comes as Saudi Arabia also carried out joint strikes with the US on Iranian proxies in Iraq, after months of Riyadh resisting being pulled into the conflict.

The US military launched a “heavy wave of strikes” against Iran in retaliation to Iran’s attempted attack on US military positions on Tuesday. The latest strikes were the first in several days to directly target the country. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed and that the “aggressor will be punished today.” It follows President Donald Trump’s earlier promise of retribution, telling reporters “it’s our turn to hit them.”

0:00 Drone hits vessels in Egyptian port; CNN's Eleni Giokos reports from Dubai
2:36 US carries out strikes on southern Iran
2:56 CNN's Kevin Liptak reports from the White House o
title: Iran war: Egypt struck for first time as conflict spreads

description: Overnight Russian strikes hit several cities across Ukraine. First responders rescued a boy from one building in Lviv, close to the border with Poland, that was struck, leaving at least 30 injured.

author: CNN
description:
Poland’s Prime Minister Donald Tusk said a missile apparently fired by Russia landed deep inside its territory early Thursday, as Moscow launched deadly long-range attacks across Ukraine that killed at least eight people. 

The missile landed and exploded about 90 kilometers (55 miles) into Polish territory early Thursday, leaving a massive crater, local authorities said. 

CNN's Clare Sebastian reports on the incident and the deadly overnight Russian strikes across Ukraine. Also, Peter Zalmayev from the Eurasia Democracy Initiative says the Poland strike may be a sign of Vladimir Putin's disdain for NATO.

description: Bodycam footage released by police in Austin, Texas, shows the moment officers fatally shoot 17-year-old Anthoneil Williams II. Police said a call reporting a young person brandishing a gun in a parking lot came from Williams' phone, and police later determined the teen was unarmed, with a water bottle in his waistband. Authorities said signs point to a possible "suicide by police," but noted this remains an active investigation.
title: Police fatally shoot Black teen after responding to 911 call

Their coach says the agility sport isn’t just for the young and adventurous, but also an effective way for seniors to move better and protect themselves from dangerous falls. #cnn #news #parkour
title: Seniors practice parkour in Singapore

author: CNN
description:
The US military has launched fresh strikes against Iran tonight. In a post on social media, US Central Command described the attacks as “a powerful response to yesterday’s attempted Iranian attacks” on US forces.

Earlier today, US President Donald Trump promised retribution after the US military said it intercepted a “surprise attack” by Iran, ending days of relative calm in the Middle East. “We’re going to be hitting them very hard because it’s our turn to hit them. They know it’s coming,” he told reporters in the Oval Office.
